task.title: Apple Watch Workout V1 Phase 1A signed archive and physical install

result.summary: Founder-authenticated Xcode automatic signing created the explicit HealthKit-capable Watch profile, produced and fully inspected a clean signed Release archive, and installed the Build 81 candidate on the Founder iPhone. Direct Watch install is now blocked only by Apple Watch Developer Mode being disabled; iPhone launch is waiting for the phone to be unlocked. Health consent and a real workout were not automated.
